reason: A media-focused plugin that bridges image uploads and targeted visual recognition for text-only models, while preserving native image handling for multimodal models.

summaries.zh: 为纯文本模型提供图片上传落盘、对话式图像识别及与原生多模态模型之间的动态桥接。
summaries.en: Provides image upload handling, conversational image recognition, and dynamic bridging between text-only and natively multimodal models.

capabilities: Accepts uploaded images and saves them to a workspace uploads directory
Provides an image_recognize tool that delegates targeted visual analysis to a configured vision model
Dynamically disables native read_image for configured text-only model sessions
Calls an external vision model for recognition and connectivity tests
Provides UI configuration and troubleshooting panels that can initiate diagnostic requests
